thread:
maya: FYI - inbound ticket: free trial blocked by fraud checks. User says they signed up with a personal email and were on a VPN. Customer is asking for credits to start testing.

fraud-bot: Automated flag triggered for account signup. Flags: disposable_email=true, vpn_detection=high, ip_risk_score=78. Reason codes: EMAIL_REPUTATION, IP_ANONYMITY.

dan: Can you paste the account id + signup metadata (email domain + IP) so I can look up the logs?

maya: Sure — redacting user name. Account snippet:
```
account_id: acct_01G7KX9Z3H4
email: testuser@mailinator.com
signup_ip: 198.51.100.23
signup_ts: 1719845178
```

olivia: Mailinator is on our disposable list, that explains disposable_email=true. IP 198.51.100.23 has VPN marker in our threat feed.

dan: Thanks. Two quick checks: 1) Did they provide a payment method? 2) Any other signals (multiple accounts from same IP or same device fingerprint)?

maya: No payment method attached. Customer says they want a dev trial only. They claim they were on a company laptop but used a travel VPN — not sure.

olivia: Without payment source, our default is to block trial grants for high-risk signals. We can do manual review if sales/CS confirms customer identity.

sanjay: Hey team — I'm the account rep. This is a warm lead, company: ClearWave Labs, not a throwaway research user. I can do a quick call to verify org email and confirm intention. Can we expedite?

dan: If Sales confirms org and we can get a corporate email (or phone verification), we can override. Process: run the admin override and record reason. I can do the override if fraud team approves.

maya: What exact info do you need from the customer for escalation?

olivia: Minimal required: 1) corporate domain or LinkedIn link showing association, 2) phone call notes, 3) consent to escalate and store verification in audit log. Sanjay — can you attach proof here?

sanjay: Adding proof: https://www.linkedin.com/company/clearwave-labs — CEO profile matches the requestor. Also shared a screenshot of their company email domain. I can do a 5-min call now.

fraud-bot: Admin note: manual overrides must include evidence. Suggested override tag: OVERRIDE_TRIAL_MANUAL; reason_code: BUSINESS_CUSTOMER_VERIFIED.

dan: Okay — I'll hold for fraud approval. @olivia can you sign off? If yes, I'll run the admin command: 
```bash
# admin console system
POST /admin/accounts/acct_01G7KX9Z3H4/flags 
{ "trial_override": true, "note": "Sales verified corporate customer (ClearWave Labs), phone verification logged" }
```

olivia: I reviewed the LinkedIn and did a quick phone check via Sanjay's notes. Approving manual override. Marking fraud queue entry as reviewed.

fraud-bot: Review logged by olivia at 1719845842. Flags cleared: disposable_email=false (manual), vpn_detection=kept (informational). OVERRIDE_TRIAL_MANUAL applied.

maya: Performed the customer-facing update: issued free trial credits and sent the onboarding email. Copied follow-up steps and redacted PII in logs.

dan: I updated the admin audit trail. Reminder: please attach the call recording or notes to the CRM ticket for compliance.

sanjay: Customer confirmed on call, very relieved. Thanks team :white_check_mark:

maya: Closing ticket; left notes about process and checklist for similar cases. If fraud ops wants a post-mortem on thresholds for VPN+disposable combos, happy to organize.

olivia: Thanks everyone — filing a short runbook tweak to clarify required evidence for manual overrides.
